text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while walking around the academy, I spot Bamboo Memory and Sakura Chiyono O standing next to one another in mysterious poses.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Wow! I can't believe even this kind of special training doesn't phase you! You're really something else!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Thank you! But to tell you the truth, I'm really feeling it in my legs!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! Actually…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Apparently, Sakura Chiyono O saw Bamboo Memory swinging her practice sword and asked for a kendo lesson.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: The way Bamboo swung her bamboo blade was so beautiful, I couldn't help but want to emulate her!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: And how could I say no after hearing something like that?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: We started off with the fundamental sonkyo stance, where you bend your knees while crouching!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Sonkyo is also practice for controlling your emotions! According to my dad…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "You can't have a real match without Sonkyo! It shows how much you value decorum!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Now, it's about time to start our next lesson!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Okay! Next up, one lap around the track in the suriashi foot slide technique!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh?! A foot slide?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's right! My dad also told me that nothing can shake you if you dedicate yourself properly to all the fundamentals.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yup! So let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Now for the last one! Ready to try swinging a practice sword?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Y-yes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And thus, Sakura Chiyono O concludes her basic training by taking her best shot at swinging a practice sword.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Without a hint of flattery, I can say Sakura Chiyono O swings the practice sword in a straight and beautiful arc.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I… did it! I really managed to pull it off!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You sure did! Great job! That was beautiful!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: It was wonderful! It's all thanks to you, Bamboo!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: No way! In fact, I should be thanking you! You've helped me get one step closer to fulfilling a dream!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: My father is honest and direct, and I want to be just like him.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: You want to be like your father?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's right. And today I was able to use the methods he taught me to get real results.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That means I'm one step closer to that dream!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: If I do my best and keep this up, I'm confident that I'll be able to stand proudly beside him one day!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I wonder…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ah, no! I need to look more solemn!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yeah. That's what my dad always used to tell himself after I won a match! …Even though he was still smiling a little!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I think I've gotta try and restrain myself too if I want to be like him! Ehehe…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't know if that's something she really needs to take so seriously, but it's kind of funny, so I decide not to say anything.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh! You want to learn kendo too?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Okay, we'll start by clearing our minds in the sonkyo crouch! Ready? Go!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: No time like the present! Besides, you're my trainer! You can definitely do it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With some encouragement from Bamboo Memory, I spend the day learning the sonkyo stance.
